description: SWAP RECORD: say that you sent a swap you were quoted, so the swap door can show it routed. You give the transaction hash you sent, the quoteHash, validUntil and pair the quote showed. FREE, a signed statement, no fee, no gas. It is recorded once per wallet and transaction, as your own statement: nothing here checks the transaction onchain, so it reads unverified, and no reward is paid or promised for it. The door refuses a record while it is not switched on or the kill switch is on, for a house wallet, and for a quote that ended more than 15 minutes ago. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the wallet that sent the swap using personal_sign, then call submit_net_swap_record within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

pair.description: The pair the quote showed: the token you sent, then >, then the token you received (written TOKEN_A>TOKEN_B).

principal.description: The 0x… address that signs: the wallet that sent the swap. Address only, never a private key.

quoteHash.description: The quoteHash the quote showed: 64 hex digits.

txHash.description: The hash of the transaction you sent: 0x and 64 hex digits.

validUntil.description: The validUntil time the quote showed, as an ISO time.

name: prepare_net_swap_record
title: Record a swap you sent through the swap door (step 1 of 2)
